derivation.behavior: Android supplies network security, credential, runtime condition and proxy facts to Go.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Android host answers cleartext, TLS, secure-secret, network-condition and proxy/PAC platform requests without leaking secrets or re-owning engine network policy.

invariants: Cleartext decisions come from Android network-security-config or platform policy and are returned as typed replies to Go.
Secret values are resolved by Android secure storage/current credential sources and only SecretRef metadata appears in logs/support bundles.
Metered, Wi-Fi, charging, battery, storage and proxy/PAC facts are host facts; Go remains the execution-policy owner.
TLS integration uses Android CA/network-security-config behavior and validates failure paths without logging certificate or credential material.
